messages:
alex: ACME is seeing JSON-mode streaming parse failures mid-stream -> client pops Unexpected token and floods retries. Started after prod deploy on 2026-03-10. Req-id: req_acme_9f2d3
maria: Can you paste the exact raw stream chunks and the SDK/version? Also need headers/timestamps.
alex: SDK: acme-internal-js v2.1. Raw chunks (as received):
```
--chunk1--
data: [{"id":"a1","price":10,"name":"widget"},
--chunk2--
{"id":"a2","price":12,"name":"gizmo"},
--chunk3--
"meta":{"src":"router","trace":"r-9f2d"},
--chunk4--
{"id":"a3","price":11,"name":"doohickey"}]
```
alex: Parser is strict (JSONStream.parse('*')) -> fails at the bare meta fragment (Unexpected token m).
sam: That looks like our per-item telemetry middleware leaked a bare object between array items instead of annotating items. We shipped a telemetry shim in commit 9f2d3a.
cheng: Post full request headers (mask tokens) + timestamps so I can correlate auth logs.
alex: Headers: Authorization: Bearer tok_*****; x-request-id: req_acme_9f2d3; route: /v1/generate?json_mode=streaming
Logs:
[2026-03-10T14:02:31Z] req_acme_9f2d3 -> 200 OK (stream start)
[2026-03-10T14:02:31Z] stream_chunk_sent size=482 id=a1
[2026-03-10T14:02:31Z] stream_chunk_sent size=498 id=a2
[2026-03-10T14:02:31Z] telemetry_inject id=meta:r-9f2d
[2026-03-10T14:02:32Z] stream_chunk_sent size=450 id=a3
[2026-03-10T14:02:32Z] client_parse_error Unexpected token m at byte 123
alex: Customer also reports intermittent 401s before this which cause reconnect loops and amplify retries.
billing-pager: We observed a ~6x increase in token billing for ACME starting at 14:02:31 UTC (req_acme_9f2d3). Retries + replayed streams count toward usage. Marking billing impact high.
support-bot: Created ticket RED-2026-4989 and attached logs.
maria: Mitigation options: 1) rollback telemetry shim (fast) 2) patch shim to emit metadata as SSE comment (e.g. ":meta ...") or embed inside each item 3) advise customer to turn off structured streaming or use tolerant parser until fixed.
sam: Opening rollback PR for shim (P0). Also will add a server-side sanitizer to drop bare meta frames when detected. Rolling back now, ETA ~15m.
cheng: Investigating auth: partner connector minted tokens with TTL < 60s causing a refresh loop. I'll coordinate with security to patch refresh logic (P1).
billing-pager: Please prepare a credit request if retries don't drop post-rollback.
alex: Attached ACME repro script: calls /v1/generate?json_mode=streaming and pipes to JSONStream.parse('*') -> strict parse fails on injected frame. I'll link the script to the ticket.
maria: Action items:
- eng-runtime (sam): rollback shim + hotfix sanitizer (P0)
- eng-security (cheng): fix partner connector token TTL handling (P1)
- support (alex): provide ACME guidance to disable structured mode and offer temporary credits; keep monitoring
- billing: prep credit path and flag account for review
sam: Rollback applied, reporting back in 10.
alex: Thx — I'll verify with customer once you confirm.
cheng: Patch for partner connector refresh queued; avoiding TTL <60s should stop those 401-triggered reconnects.
billing-pager: Noted. If rollback removes parse failures, billing spike should resolve; if not, escalate to #incidents.
alex: ACME reports reduced parse failures after our rollback test. Keeping ticket open until EOD and will update RCA when auth patch lands.
maria: We'll follow up with RCA and a postmortem if billing credit is requested.
